infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Safe-Her uses your location to analyse route safety and share emergency alerts with trusted contacts when SOS is active.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Safe-Her uses background location to keep SOS tracking active while the app is minimised.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Background location tracking is used only during an active SOS session to share your latest coordinates.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Safe-Her to use your location even when the app is in the background — used only during SOS.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Safe-Her to access your location to show safe routes and prepare emergency alerts.
